knowledgeAnswers.rationale: Bulk stock belongs in clean storage, outside the contaminated side. The other options place supplies where contamination lands.
Fresh gloves are needed for the cleaning task. The other options keep contamination on the hands or skip the wipe.
Clean-to-contaminated is the only direction for stock, and contaminated items never return to clean areas. The other options reverse or ignore the rule.

practicalCriteria: Given a mock operatory, the learner identifies the clean and contaminated sides and places a restock box on the correct side.
The learner changes gloves before wiping a mock chair control and states why.
passRule: 80% on knowledge checks; practical sign-off separate
evidenceRequired: Assessor observation record for the mock operatory
stopWorkCriteria: Contaminated items are found in clean storage and no supervisor is available
A treatment is in progress in the room
